lexhaiti.title: LexHaïti Public
lexhaiti.description: The complete corpus of Haitian law — free, bilingual, citable.
lexhaiti.lead: The complete corpus of Haitian law — Constitution, codes, statutes, decrees — free, bilingual, citable.
lexhaiti.what_body: A web platform giving access to the full body of Haitian positive law to anyone with an internet connection — no sign-up, no advertising, no tracking. Each text is structured article by article, permanently citable, and progressively translated into Kreyòl.
lexhaiti.why_body: A country's law must belong to its citizens. Today, accessing an up-to-date Haitian code requires either buying an expensive paper volume or navigating scattered PDFs. LexHaïti fixes this structural gap.
lexhaiti.for_body: Citizens, lawyers, students, researchers, journalists, civil servants, diaspora. Anyone who needs to know or cite a legal norm.

about.title: About us
about.description: The team and vision behind Ayiti Dijital — a Haitian association for public digital infrastructure.
about.intro: Ayiti Dijital is a non-profit association currently being founded in Munich as an e.V. (under German law). Our mission: build and maintain digital platforms of public interest for Haiti.
about.mission_body: Build and maintain Haiti's public digital infrastructure — freely accessible, in French and Kreyòl, designed to last beyond political cycles. From law to domain names, from civic data to open tools.
about.vision_body: A Haiti where basic digital infrastructure — law, domain names, civic data — belongs to the public, is freely accessible, and is designed to last beyond political and economic cycles.
about.structure_intro: Ayiti Dijital brings together two complementary entities under one common mission: build and sustain Haiti's public digital infrastructure.

structure_entities.name: Ayiti Dijital e.V.
structure_entities.role: Operates the public goods (LexHaïti Public), receives grants, donations and membership fees, safeguards the digital commons.

structure_entities.name: Ayiti Digital Labs GmbH
structure_entities.role: Holder of the LexHaïti® trademark, operates the professional products (LexHaïti Pro, .ht services). A share of its revenue flows back to the association.

principles.title: The commons first
principles.body: Everything that is a public good — the law, civic data, source code — stays free and will remain so. No paywall on access to the law. Paid professional services (LexHaïti Pro, .ht domains), operated separately by our commercial sister company, fund and protect this commons — they never replace it.

principles.title: Open
principles.body: Open source code, reusable data, open standards. Institutions must be able to pick up our work at any time.

principles.title: Bilingual
principles.body: Everything is designed for French and Kreyòl, with no hierarchy between the two languages.

principles.title: Durable
principles.body: Frugal architecture, minimal dependencies. Our platforms must run with few resources, for a long time.

team.name: Glory Pracht
team.bio: Founder of HDDI e.V. and Ayiti Dijital. Based in Munich, he has been leading the mission since 2025.

privacy.rights_intro: The GDPR grants you a set of rights over your personal data. To exercise them, write to kontakt@ayitidijital.org — we respond within 30 days.

rights_cards.title: Right of access
rights_cards.body: Obtain a copy of the data we hold about you.

rights_cards.title: Right to rectification
rights_cards.body: Correct any inaccurate or incomplete data.

rights_cards.title: Right to erasure
rights_cards.body: Request deletion of your data — unless a legal obligation requires otherwise.

rights_cards.title: Right to restriction
rights_cards.body: Restrict the processing of your data in certain cases.

rights_cards.title: Right to portability
rights_cards.body: Receive your data in a structured, reusable format.

rights_cards.title: Right to object
rights_cards.body: Object to the processing of your data at any time.

privacy.rights_complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Bavarian data protection authority (BayLfD): datenschutz-bayern.de.
privacy.hosting_body: This site is hosted on infrastructure located in the European Union. No third-party analytics or advertising tools are used.
privacy.contact_body: For any question about the protection of your data — exercising your rights, complaints, requests — write to us directly.
